name: Irish Chain
description: Single Irish chain: nine-patch blocks set checkerwise with plain ones, so small squares run in chains along both diagonals, each plain block quilted with a stitched ring.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --nine: linear-gradient(@var(--k), @var(--k)) 0% 0% / 33.33% 33.33% no-repeat, linear-gradient(@var(--k), @var(--k)) 100% 0% / 33.33% 33.33% no-repeat, linear-gradient(@var(--k), @var(--k)) 0% 100% / 33.33% 33.33% no-repeat, linear-gradient(@var(--k), @var(--k)) 100% 100% / 33.33% 33.33% no-repeat; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @var(--nine), none); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, 33.33%, 14%); border-radius: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, 0%, 50%); background: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)), @p(var(--color1))); opacity: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, 1, 0.55); -webkit-mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, none, @var(--ring)); mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, none, @var(--ring)); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ring: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0deg 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg, #000 30deg 45deg, transparent 45deg 60deg, #000 60deg 75deg, transparent 75deg 90deg, #000 90deg 105deg, transparent 105deg 120deg, #000 120deg 135deg, transparent 135deg 150deg, #000 150deg 165deg, transparent 165deg 180deg, #000 180deg 195deg, transparent 195deg 210deg, #000 210deg 225deg, transparent 225deg 240deg, #000 240deg 255deg, transparent 255deg 270deg, #000 270deg 285deg, transparent 285deg 300deg, #000 300deg 315deg, transparent 315deg 330deg, #000 330deg 345deg, transparent 345deg 360deg), radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 88%, #000 88% 100%, transparent 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
